series: Adapt-1 Research Series — Part 2: Forecasting Through Drift
title: Online Probability Models (Stateful /value/* Learners)
provenance: Empirical market telemetry (Binance perpetual funding, Yahoo Finance / FRED / CBOE macro series, German SMARD day-ahead power & Open-Meteo weather) evaluated under strict score-before-ingest causal walk-forward protocols against Adapt-1 /value/* API.

metric_definitions.brier: Mean squared probability error mean((clip(p, 1e-6, 1-1e-6) - y)^2); lower is better.
metric_definitions.log_loss: Binary cross-entropy -mean(y*log(p) + (1-y)*log(1-p)) with p clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]; lower is better.
metric_definitions.ece: 10-bin equal-width Expected Calibration Error on [0, 1] with p clipped to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]; lower is better.
metric_definitions.auroc: Area under ROC curve (exact Mann-Whitney U with average tie ranks); higher is better.
metric_definitions.significance_testing: ISO-week clustered Bartlett Newey-West HAC (n >= 30 weeks) or exact 2^n sign-flip permutation (n <= 20 weeks), with unpruned step-down Holm-Bonferroni correction across the full comparator family.

api_config.episode_id_scheme: bar_{t:06d} (shared across BTC/ETH/SOL on bar t)
api_config.update_policy: Block 0 install=True; Blocks 1..35 install=False with observation_ids[-4608:] and model_source=candidate

chronological_split_ablation.mechanism: Chronological validation holds out the newest 20% of bar-episodes (68-102 days) purely for early stopping without refitting weights on them, creating a recency blind spot under crypto regime shifts.

columns.<model_name>: Predicted probability P(next 8h funding rate < 0) rounded to 4 decimals (6 decimals within 0.005 of 0 or 1; 21 model columns)

api_config.episode_id_scheme: day_{t:06d} (shared across all 8 assets on trading day t)

exp_100a_install_lockout_audit.title: Validation-Gated Install Lockout Audit (Realized Volatility & German Power)

finding_summary.vol_abs_r_expanding_retained: 36/42 (85.7%) blocks returned status='retained' (only 6 weight installs across 42 blocks)
finding_summary.vol_rv5_fwd_expanding_retained: 32/42 (76.2%) blocks returned status='retained' (only 10 weight installs across 42 blocks)

power_expanding_retained_per_target.ev_peak_spike_200: 14/18 retained + 3/18 rejected (12 consecutive retained blocks 1..12, then 3 rejected, then 2 retained; 0 post-Block-0 installs)

finding_summary.reconciliation_note: The blog cites '32-36/42 vol blocks and 12-17/18 power blocks' from the Exp 100A report prose. The exact raw block telemetry in exp100a_install_lockout_blocks.csv matches 32/42 and 36/42 on volatility exactly, and shows 14/18 (12 consecutive retained before 3 rejected, then 2 retained), 16/18, and 17/18 retained blocks on the three 18-block expanding German power arms (0/42 and 0/18 status='retained' under sliding install=False candidate updates).
finding_summary.mitigation: Train Block 0 with install=True to seed the session, then retrain subsequent sliding windows with explicit observation_ids, install=False, warm_start_source='candidate', and score via model_source='candidate'.

columns.target: Forecast target (abs_r, rv5_fwd, ev_peak_spike_200, ev_neg_midday, p_peak)
columns.block_idx: Sequential retrain block index (0..41 for vol, 0..17 for power)
columns.n_buffer_total: Total causally observed records at retrain time
columns.n_train_selected: Number of training records selected for the block retrain
columns.train_status: Server training outcome (trained, candidate, retained, rejected, rejected_abstained_prior)
columns.weights_updated: 1 if active model weights changed from the previous block, 0 if frozen/retained
columns.weights_version: Anonymized sequential integer weight version (1, 2, ..., or 0 when abstained) replacing raw model hashes
columns.warm_start_applied: 1 if warm start from prior weights was applied, 0 otherwise
columns.train_wall_s: End-to-end retrain wall time in seconds
